mapper.sql: id, document_id, task_version, task_status, source_object_key, full_object_key, preview_object_key, page_count, failure_reason, started_time, finished_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.select: select from wl_document_conversion where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
select coalesce(max(task_version), 0) + 1 from wl_document_conversion where document_id = #{documentId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into wl_document_conversion(document_id, task_version, task_status, source_object_key, full_object_key, preview_object_key, page_count, failure_reason, started_time, finished_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag) values(#{documentId}, #{taskVersion}, #{taskStatus}, #{sourceObjectKey}, null, null, null, null, null, null, #{createBy}, now(), '', now(), '0')
mapper.update: update wl_document_conversion set task_status = 'CONVERTING', started_time = now(), finished_time = null, failure_reason = null, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and task_status = 'PENDING' and del_flag = '0'

update wl_document_conversion set task_status = 'SUCCESS', full_object_key = #{fullObjectKey}, preview_object_key = #{previewObjectKey}, page_count = #{pageCount}, failure_reason = null, finished_time = now(), update_time = now() where id = #{id} and task_status = 'CONVERTING' and del_flag = '0'

update wl_document_conversion set task_status = 'FAILED', failure_reason = #{failureReason}, finished_time = now(), update_time = now() where id = #{id} and task_status = 'CONVERTING' and del_flag = '0'
